method: Affected-only post-freeze correction; full 70-row v1 regression retained separately.

cases.source: Treatment A produced 7 responses and treatment B produced 11 responses. These counts cannot be compared fairly without knowing how many participants received each treatment. The denominator matters as well as the numerator.

Perlakuan A menghasilkan 7 respons dan perlakuan B menghasilkan 11 respons. Jumlah ini tidak dapat dibandingkan secara adil tanpa mengetahui berapa peserta yang menerima setiap perlakuan. Penyebut sama pentingnya dengan pembilang.
